description: Use when the user (as a developer) asks 'what OAuth apps do I own?', 'list my RPs', or needs the app id before adding/removing a redirect_uri. Read-only. Returns id, name, client_id, status, and current redirect_uris for every app the PAK owner can manage. Requires PAK scope apps:read or apps:manage. Do NOT use to list end-user authorized apps — that's logi_list_connected_apps.
name: logi_list_apps
